Choose the official WebApp for the Desktop workspace without a separate WebUI installation. Choose WebUI for the community web interface. Follow the setup and sign-in steps, then paste the reusable server URL above (or use Add server). Never save a temporary sign-in link. Prefer HTTPS and a trusted VPN; localhost on your phone is not your server.

Your Hermes agent, in your pocket
Hermes-Android is a remote control for the Hermes Agent running on your own computer or server. Your agent keeps running where it is, and this app is the window into it.
Choose your interface
Hermes-Android works with either of these. Pick one now and change it later in Settings.
Hermes WebUI
The community web interface for Hermes Agent, with chat, sessions and workspace tools.
View on GitHub
Hermes Agent Webapp
The official Hermes Agent workspace. It is off by default, so enable it on your computer first (Hermes Agent v0.22.6 or newer).
Read the setup docs
Let your agent set it up
Copy a ready-made command, then paste it into your existing Hermes chat on the computer or server that runs Hermes. Your agent will walk you through the setup.
These are instructions for your agent, not terminal commands. Copying does not install anything or check your phone\'s connection.
Reaching Hermes away from home
At home your phone can reach your computer over Wi-Fi. Away from home it needs a private route back, such as a VPN or secure tunnel. Tailscale is a popular choice, and there are alternatives:
Keep Hermes sign-in turned on and avoid opening router ports to the internet.
You\'re ready to connect
Next, enter the address of your Hermes server. You can reopen this guide any time from Settings.
